1: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
2: Psalm one eighteen, twenty-four. Before you start your day, hand the whole thing to God.
3: You woke up this morning. That breath in your chest was given to you.
4: I used to grab my phone first, and the day had me before I stood up.
5: The verse never promises you an easy day. It tells you who made it.
6: If He made today, He already knows what's in it. None of it surprises Him.
7: He led Israel with a cloud by day and a fire by night.
8: They never got the whole map. They got enough light for the day they were in.
9: So let's pray. Right where you are, before the day gets loud.
10: Father, thank You for waking us up. We didn't earn this morning. You gave it.
11: We put today in Your hands: the job, our family, and the thing we can't fix.
12: Order our steps today, and make us glad in it. In Jesus' name, amen.
13: Today, before you open one app, say it out loud: Lord, this day is Yours.
14: If you're giving Him today, comment Amen, and send this to somebody who needs it.
15: I'm Derrick Hughes. This is Blessed Prayers. Have a blessed day.
